question_text: Was the expo floor busier before the morning keynote or after it? Compare the average crowd at the expo floor during 07:00-09:00 versus 10:00-12:00.
answer_text: The expo floor was significantly busier after the morning keynote, with an average crowd of 179.94 during 10:00-12:00, compared to an average crowd of 5.605 during 07:00-09:00.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.camera_location CONTAINS 'ExpoFloor' AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T07:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T09:00:00Z'
  RETURN '07:00-09:00' AS time_period, avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_crowd
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.camera_location CONTAINS 'ExpoFloor' AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T10:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T12:00:00Z'
  RETURN '10:00-12:00' AS time_period, avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_crowd
}
RETURN time_period, avg_crowd ORDER BY time_period
